messages.subject: For Vincent Clerc | Government affairs, logistics and country stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Løv,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Vincent Clerc, Chief Executive Officer.

Maersk's global logistics platform depends on strong alignment across governments, ports, infrastructure partners, customers and country stakeholders. That intersection closely matches the work I lead today in a complex operating environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior institutional engagement, coordinate complex cross-functional matters across corporate and technical teams, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, external affairs, country stakeholder strategy and institutional coordination might support Maersk's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to A.P. Moller - Maersk.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
